Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The nadir of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, weighted by independent path length, no identity may audit its own recruit.
